$comment: Client-defined hooks for the bro plugin. SessionStart rehydrates beads context (ready work + active drill frame) so a fresh session or post-compaction agent resumes from bd state, not transcript. Commands are best-effort — `command -v` guards make every hook a silent no-op when bd/bro is absent, and a timeout bounds a stalled bd.

hooks.command: command -v bd >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; bd ready 2>/dev/null | head -20; command -v bro >/dev/null 2>&1 && bro drill current || true
command -v bro >/dev/null 2>&1 && bro drill current || true
